compute: local_full_research; no remote server or mandatory reduced pilot phase
cache_ownership: each question writes only its qN namespace; runtime owner maintains runtime; append immutable versions
historical_policy: round1/round2 research packets, manifests and audit records immutable; shared code upgrades bound to new baseline; old code integrity at historical Git refs

q1.validation: year and weather-process grouped; overlap purge; fit transforms on background/training only

q4.initial_conditions: observationally constrained or explicitly scenario-specified; same source/terrain/volume for comparable experiments
q4.arrival_output: relative travel time at separately versioned target; initiation kept separate

bundles.file_path_policy: repo-relative for committed packet files; absolute immutable cache paths allowed with provenance; no self-entry
bundles.adoption: main advisor hash-checks and delivers versioned consumer inputs; producer originals preserved

q2_state_exchange.format: CSV long table or Parquet with documented equivalent columns
q2_state_exchange.failure_margin_sign: positive stable; zero critical; negative beyond stated criterion; model supplies dimensional/normalized definition
q2_state_exchange.missing_or_never_crossed: preserve null or no_start flag; never drop to manufacture initiation probability
q2_state_exchange.parameters: named values/units/source plus grid or explicit prior/weights; no probability assigned merely because range exists

q4_release_exchange.absent_fields: null with context; produce explicitly specified scenario for required computation rather than claim measured

q4_propagation_exchange.time_origin: relative to supplied release; no automatic replacement of first mechanical initiation truth

acquisition_policy: new round permits necessary public scenes, regional products, cases and model material; prior 128MiB/single-pair limit not inherited; public legal alternative routes after endpoint failure; no automated account creation, payment or contacting others
